item.title: Army Opens 50-Printer Additive Makerspace at Picatinny Arsenal - 3D Printing
item.description: The U.S. Army cut the ribbon on a new Additive Makerspace at Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey on March 19, giving engineers at the DEVCOM Armaments Center access to more than 50 3D printers under one roof.
